name: Creative Mode
avoid_for: Contexts that demand institutional restraint and a quiet authority — the saturated multi-accent palette will read as expressive, not formal
weak_cases: Dense factual detail can disappear amid accent collision; shadows need separation from data marks.
visual_signature: Heavy ink outlines, hard offset shadows, uppercase display and colliding flat accents.

provenance.adaptation: Recipe retained and curated for Deck Studio; selector describes source-supported structures, not rendered acceptance.

language_posture: Uppercase display and mono metadata may lose contrast in other scripts; structural blocks can preserve the hierarchy.

assets.images: No image required; type, shapes and surface treatments can carry the system.
